_comment: Phase 3a ground-visual overhaul (real biome-driven terrain surfaces, The Crew 2 art-direction target - see unreal/apply_ground_material.py). CC0 PBR sets from ambientCG (https://ambientcg.com) - the whole site is published CC0 1.0 (public domain, no attribution required; see https://ambientcg.com/about). All zips fetched at 2K-PNG resolution via ambientCG's public download API (https://ambientcg.com/get?file=<AssetId>_2K-PNG.zip), no login required. Same convention as content_src/textures/road/ (download script + manifest.json ARE committed, extracted binaries are NOT - see repo .gitignore).

textures.notes: Summit County valley-floor/meadow base layer - low elevation, flat ground, PlainsGrassland/RockyFoothill/DeciduousForest biome tints multiply over this.
Mossy/lichen-covered ground - blended in under EvergreenForest biome tint for the conifer-forest slopes.
Packed dirt/sparse patchy grass - road-verge dusty-shoulder blend and general dirt breakup on the grass layer.
Steep-slope exposed rock face - sampled triplanar (world XY + XZ/YZ) so it doesn't stretch on near-vertical cliffs.
Loose broken-rock talus - AlpineBare/ArcticTundra biome base above treeline, distinct from the bedrock rock_cliff layer.
Altitude snow-line layer above ~3500 m equivalent, noise-broken-up blend over rock/scree/grass beneath it.
